title: Sindiket gagal seludup lebih empat tan minyak masak ke Thailand
summary: KOTA BHARU – Cubaan sindiket untuk menyeludup sebanyak lebih empat tan minyak masak bersubsidi ke Thailand menggunakan lima buah kenderaan gagal selepas Kementerian Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup (KPDN) Kelantan menyerbu kawasan Kampung Kubang Chetok dekat Pasir Mas malam tadi. title_en: Syndicate failed to smuggle over four tons of cooking oil into Thailand
summary_en: KOTA BHARU – A gang attempted to smuggle more than four tons of subsidized cooking oil into Thailand using five vehicles failed after Kelantan’s Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN) raided the area of Kampung Kubang Chetok near Pasir Mas last night.
